name: Premier Electronics
old_description: We specialize in providing Tier 1 capabilities and quality with the customer attention and flexibility of a dynamic manufacturing partner.
about:
Premier Electronics operates from Sugar Land, Texas, providing electronics manufacturing services. The company has been in operation since at least 2016, as indicated by its copyright notice, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been published.

The shop runs two high-speed Samsung SMT lines that have sextupled capacity over the past year, supporting both prototype and production volumes. Core processes include surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly with exotic component placement, chassis and box builds, cable and wire harness fabrication, panel assembly, system integration, potting, and conformal coating. Additional value-added services encompass MRP-based production planning, supply chain management, order fulfillment, and third-party inventory stocking.

Customers span oil and gas, ruggedized commercial devices, medical, police and military peripherals, and security cameras for school districts. A purchasing manager at an industrial gas company noted that the firm grew from a single part number to become their largest supplier over a decade.

Premier positions itself as a Tier 1-capable partner that combines advanced equipment with flexible scheduling to accelerate onshoring and reduce total cost. Its differentiators include FCA (Chrysler) approval, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and RoHS-compliant assembly for 98 percent of output.
